verdict.rationale: Mock servers are a fair capability to ask of an API client like Hoppscotch, but nothing in the evidence pack documents creating or hosting a mock server from saved examples or a spec. OpenAPI import (hoppscotch-docs-15) only brings requests into collections and does not serve mock responses, and one user reports the product 'can't save specific responses like Postman', so the story's core is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up a mock server from saved examples or a spec so consumers can build before the API exists
